note: Q.44 a.1 ad 2 says an agent cause is required because the effect would not be if the cause were not. The premise reads this as a primitive dependence relation (DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING) indexed to whatever is efficiently caused in any respect, using the secunda via's EfficientlyCausesIn; the passage gives a reason for requiring an agent cause and does not itself state the universal dependence premise in this vocabulary.
